description: Transcribe a Voice Memos recording, extract action items via the configured LLM, and create Reminders. Commits by default in agent mode; pass dryRun=true to preview.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

memo.description: Memo UUID or prefix (default: most recent recording).

provider.description: AI provider: ollama, claude, openai, or apple (default: ai.provider, else ollama).

title: memos_capture_to_reminders: arguments
